context: The scheduled November 1 eligibility time passed, but the newest retrieved tracker snapshot predates it and no raw post-event XRPL response was obtained.
decision: Separate FinishAfter eligibility from EscrowFinish execution.
Require a validated ledger index and raw account_objects plus account_tx evidence for both owner accounts.
Verify transaction metadata and affected nodes before recording destination receipt.
Follow destination transfers and EscrowCreate transactions before estimating net outside-escrow XRP.
Do not treat destination balance changes, exchange deposits, ETF holdings or gross release amounts as actual sales or net external capital without additional evidence.
Do not admit this event as a predictive feature until source timestamps and same-ledger corroboration pass quality checks.

source_freshness_rule.required: Two independent public data paths or one raw validated XRPL node response plus an independent explorer cross-check.

next_action: Obtain post-eligibility account_objects/account_tx from public XRPL JSON-RPC and record validated ledger sequence, hashes, metadata, destinations and follow-on disposition.
